elements.name: Inspect the part root context menu

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active saved part in the MCAD Software contains one visible solid block
the document root row is visible in the model browser
the user right-clicks the document root row
the root row is highlighted and the visible block edges are blue
the context menu offers file-location and file-path actions
the context menu offers drawing actions
the context menu offers Expand All Children, Collapse All Children and Find in Window
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes and the block edges remain highlighted
the user clicks empty viewport space
the blue edge highlighting disappears and the block remains visible

elements.name: Show and hide an origin axis from its browser menu

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded and the X Axis is hidden
the user right-clicks the X Axis row
the row is highlighted and the axis is highlighted in blue in the viewport
Visibility is unchecked and Auto Resize is checked in the context menu
the user chooses Visibility and clicks empty viewport space
the axis remains visible as a line beside the block
the user right-clicks the X Axis row again
Visibility is checked in the context menu
the user chooses Visibility again
the axis is hidden and the block remains visible

elements.name: Show and hide an origin plane from its browser menu

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the YZ origin plane is hidden and its browser row is visible
the user right-clicks the YZ Plane row
the context menu offers Visibility and New Sketch
Visibility is not checked
the user chooses Visibility and clicks empty viewport space
the plane remains visible as a translucent plane beside the block
the user right-clicks the YZ Plane row again
Visibility is checked
the user chooses Visibility again
the plane is hidden and the block remains visible

elements.name: Inspect the center point context menu

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
the user right-clicks the Center Point row
the Center Point row is highlighted
its context menu offers Copy, Measure, Create Note and Visibility
the menu offers Relationships
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

elements.name: Collapse descendants of the Origin folder

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Origin folder is expanded with its planes, axes and center point visible as rows
the user right-clicks the Origin folder
its context menu offers Expand All Children and collapses All Children
the user chooses Collapse All Children
the Origin folder remains expanded with its direct reference rows visible
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user clicks the Origin expansion control
the reference rows are hidden and the Origin folder remains visible
the user clicks the Origin expansion control again
the reference rows are visible again

elements.name: Navigate relationships from an origin plane

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part in the MCAD Software contains a sketch on the XY plane and an extrusion using that sketch
the user chooses Relationships from the XY plane row context menu
the dialog identifies the XY plane as the selected item
the Parents list is empty
the Children list contains the sketch and the extrusion
the user activates the navigation control beside the sketch
the sketch becomes the selected item in the dialog
the Parents list contains the XY plane and center point
the Children list contains the extrusion
the user activates the navigation control beside the XY plane
the XY plane becomes the selected item again
the Parents list is empty
the Children list contains the sketch and the extrusion
the user clicks Done
the Relationships dialog closes

elements.name: Inspect an origin plane with no listed relationships

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part in the MCAD Software contains a sketch on the XY plane and an extrusion using it
the user chooses Relationships from the YZ plane row context menu
the dialog identifies the YZ plane as the selected item
the Parents list is empty
the Children list is empty
the user clicks Done
the Relationships dialog closes
the YZ plane remains highlighted in the viewport

elements.name: Inspect the extrusion row context menu

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a block created by an extrusion
the extrusion row is visible in the model browser
the user right-clicks the extrusion row
the row is highlighted and the block edges are highlighted in blue
the context menu offers Edit Sketch and Edit Feature
the context menu offers Show Dimensions, Measure and Properties
the context menu offers Expand All Children and collapses All Children
the user dismisses the menu and clicks empty viewport space
the context menu and blue edge highlighting disappear
the block remains visible
